props.title: Little Moses Jones
props.lede: You know what happens at a party when the first bars of Regulate come on and everyone starts singing along. Little Moses Jones is a six-piece band that keeps that feeling going all night, with the 90s and 2000s R&B and hip-hop your guests grew up on and the verses rapped live.
props.headingNote: We’ll work with you on the songs, and even on what the band wears. Here’s how booking through Signet works.

props.title: Little Moses Jones, the 2026 promo, clean version

props.html: Little Moses Jones has two singers up front, and behind them the bandleader plays keys and horns alongside guitar, bass and drums. They play straight through with no gaps between the songs, which helps keep your guests dancing.
The band can play a clean show for an office party or a gala and the full lyrics for a late-night party - just let us know which you’d like when you send the date.

The band has been playing live for nearly two decades. It has played for Google, Pearson and a Denver Broncos pregame, galas for the Boys and Girls Club and the Denver Children's Foundation, festival stages at Parker Days, Burro Days and Juneteenth in Thornton, and dates in Amsterdam and Mexico. In 2022 the LUXlife awards named it Colorado's wedding band of the year.
The band brings its own sound engineer, so you usually won’t need a separate audio company.

rows.text: People from every department tend to know these songs, so you won’t have to talk anyone into dancing, whether you’re at a downtown Denver venue or your own office.
Once the program is over, this is the band to book when you want everyone letting loose.
If your friends were in high school when these songs were on the radio, this is the band you want for a big birthday at a venue with space to dance.
This is a great choice if you want people dancing from the first song.

props.html: We’ll plan the music around your speeches and program, so let us know the flow of the evening. Wondering about prices? Our Live Music Cost Guide covers what live music costs across Colorado.

props.title: A sample of their songs.
props.lede: Want to hear them live? You can watch the band play every one of these songs in our video clips.
props.more: Beyond these, they play songs by Usher, TLC, Destiny’s Child, Mary J. Blige, Nelly and Montell Jordan, along with the soul and funk songs that inspired them. They can also play their original songs at your event if you ask.

items.q: How long does the band play?
items.a: Their sets can run from 60 to 90 minutes, with up to 3 hours of music across your event, and we’ll plan the breaks around your program.

items.q: Will they learn our first dance?
items.a: Yes. The band can learn a first dance or one special song if you ask, and we’ll take your must-plays and must-avoids ahead of time.
Yes. They can play the Front Range and the mountain towns, too.
